responsibility: This file implements the default support logic behind GCC’s value_query and range_query abstractions. It supplies fallback conversions from ranges to singleton values, default edge and statement queries in terms of expression queries, helpers for deriving vranges from constants, SSA range info, pointer nonnull facts, and simple arithmetic tree expressions, and the global_range_query instance that answers from SSA_NAME_RANGE_INFO and pointer info. It is the shared adapter layer that turns raw range providers into a uniform value/range query API for optimizers.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable default behavior behind the interfaces in value-query.h, including fallback value/range query methods, global SSA/pointer range extraction, relation querying hooks, and the global_range_query instance.
